narration.text: Why orbit gets 144% of Earth's best sunlight.
In space, there's no night, clouds or air.
In 2023, Caltech's MAPLE beamed power down to Earth.
It sent just 3.2 watts, a proof of concept.
Viable plants need launch costs of $100 to $200 per kilogram.
China has talked of a 200-tonne station by 2035.
So space solar power is waiting on rockets, not sunlight.
